Commentary.Commentary: Now, it's over to Sri Lanka's batting. It's going to be a big challenge for them on this pitch which has some juice for the fast bowlers. The trio of Kyle Abbott, Kagiso Rabada and Vernon Philander will be a real threat and the visitors will have to apply themselves in order to succeed. Stay tuned for their reply.

Sri Lanka will be buoyed with their overall performance so far in this Test. After a 104-run opening stand, the signs were ominous for the Lankans but they showed a lot of character by bouncing back and bundling out the hosts inside the 300-run mark. South Africa will be disappointed with their batsmen as plenty of them got starts but failed to convert.

Outstanding bowling show by Sri Lanka! They continued from where they left yesterday and picked the remaining four wickets in 53 balls by conceding just 19 runs. Nuwan Pradeep picked up a couple of wickets while Suranga Lakmal added one to his overnight tally and grabbed his first fifer in Tests.

OUT! Timberrr!! Pradeep spears in a terrific inswinging yorker, de Kock tries to dig it out but is beaten for movement and pace. The ball sneaks through before his bat comes down and goes on to destroy the stumps. SOUTH AFRICA ALL OUT FOR 286!
A bit short in length again, on off, de Kock once again slaps it through point and denies the single.
Angles in a touch short of a length ball on off, de Kock moves back to make some space and then guides it towards third man. No run taken.
FOUR! Shot! Pradeep lands it full and outside off, de Kock latches onto it with all his might and bludgeons it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in with extra bounce, de Kock takes his bottom hand off the handle and pushes it  through mid-wicket. Denies the single.
Switches to over the wicket and hurls in a good length ball on middle and off, Rabada nicely gets behind the line and defends it to the off side. Safely negotiated.
Spears in a full ball from around the wicket, it's close to the off stump line and Rabada jams it down safely.
Back of a length ball on off, it's punched through covers for a single this time. Rabada has two balls to survive.
Once again it's short and wide outside off, Quinton slaps it through backward point. Another run turned down.
Width on offer outside off, short in length, de Kock punches it from the crease to widish long off and denies the single.
Full and angling into the batsman, de Kock gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Good length ball on off, de Kock defends it off his back foot.
Shortish and angled into the batsman, Rabada fends at it and edges it behind. Luckily for him it doesn't carry to the slip cordon.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Rabada gets behind the line and pushes it to the on side.
Kagiso Rabada is the last batsman.

OUT! Terrible mix-up and Abbott is run out! Short and wide outside off, de Kock hangs back and slaps it through point for a single. He turns for the second run as well and Abbott responds. But Quinton stutters after seeing the fielder firing in the throw and sends his partner back. Abbott has no chance of getting back in as Chandimal takes the bails off in a jiffy.
FOUR! With wickets falling at the other end, de Kock's approach will be quite clear. He receives room outside off and drills it through covers for a boundary. Expect many more of those now from him!
Excellent delivery again, bowls it full and just outside off, holding its line, once again Kyle pushes inside the line and misses.
On a good length and around off, moving away a shade, Abbott pushes at it from the crease and misses.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Kyle Abbott is in next.

OUT! MAIDEN TEST FIFER FOR LAKMAL! Beautiful bowling and well deserved. Bowls a nice outswinger around off, on a fuller length, Maharaj pushes at it tentatively from the crease and nicks it behind. Chandimal dives to his right to complete a good catch. South Africa are going down quickly.
Full in length on off, Maharaj gets squared up a bit in defense and keeps it out off the outer half of the bat to covers. Looks for a run but his partner sends him back.
A forward short leg comes into place.
Full in length and outside off, going straight on, Maharaj sticks to his crease and then lets it through.
Angles in a full ball again, around off, de Kock tries to work it on the leg side but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Fullish and angling into the batsman, de Kock pushes it down from the crease to mid on.
Keshav Maharaj is the new batsman.

OUT! Philander has been bounced out! It was a ploy by Pradeep which he used in his last over as well but without any success. But this time it has reaped rich dividends. Bangs in a short ball with a fielder in the deep on the leg side. Philander takes the challenge of pulling it across the line but fails to control the extra bounce. It takes the top edge and Chameera in the deep mid-wicket region grabs a diving catch. First success for Sri Lanka this morning.
Philander has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Oohhh...that missed the off stump by a whisker. Pradeep dishes out a good length ball on off and it shapes back in a shade, Philander decides to leave it alone and it goes perilously past the off stump. Heart in mouth stuff!
Slants in a fuller length ball on middle, straightening a bit, Philander plays it off his pads and pushes it to mid on.

Good delivery, drops it on a length outside off and gets it to move back in a long way. De Kock once again shuffles across to cover his stumps and then leaves it. It wasn't very far from the off stump.
Fuller in length and outside off, de Kock lunges and softly pushes it with an angled bat to gully.
Lands it on a length and just outside off, de Kock gets across the stumps to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Pitches it full and on off, angling in, de Kock strides forward and defends it to the cover region.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Quinton doesn't commit himself into any shot and allows it through to the keeper.
Lakmal operates from around the wicket and hurls in a length ball outside off, it straightens a touch after hitting the deck, de Kock feels for it and gets beaten.
On a length and outside off, Philander reaches out for it and pushes it to covers.

DROPPED! Pradeep hurries up the batsman with a short ball around the rib cage, Philander tries pulling it over square leg but ends up gloving it behind. Chandimal flies to his left but only manages a few fingertips on it. Deflects it down towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Pradeep digs in a short ball and it goes over the head of Philander. One for the over signals the square leg umpire.
The wind is blowing from right to left from this end. The bowler will have to make necessary adjustment to use it to his advantage.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock cuts it through point for a single.
On a length and angling across, it lands on off and de Kock goes back to defend it towards the bowler.
Fuller and straighter, Vernon helps it through mid-wicket and by the time the mid on fielder moves across to his right to stop the ball, they take a single.
Identical to the last delivery, once again de Kock defends it a shade uncomfortably. Not quite from the middle of the willow.
Length ball on off, de Kock lunges to defend but gets it off the inside half of the bat.
Lands it full and outside off, de Kock plays a nicely timed cover drive but straight to the fielder.
Rod Tucker who was the third umpire has been changed as he is ill. In comes, Shaun George in his place.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full in length around off, Quinton gets back and taps it down to gully.
A gentle loosener in the zone outside off, angling away from the southpaw, de Kock shoulders arms.
Suranga Lakmal in search of his fifth wicket will be bowling from the other end.
Angles in a full ball on off, Philander has to play at it and he does so from the crease. Keeps it out safely on the off side to end the first over of day 2!

Hurls it closer to the off stump line, on a length and holding its line, Vernon allows it through to the keeper. Which ball to play, which one to leave is an important decision and Philander so far has done it nicely.
That's better. That is where he needs to be. Bowls it full and angling in around off, it straightens a touch after landing, Philander gets behind the line and blocks it to the off side.

FOUR! That's a really good shot! The delivery is not much different from the last one but there is some extra room on offer. Philander immediately goes on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Drops it on a length and in the channel outside off, Philander leaves it watchfully.
Starts with a good length ball on middle, de Kock works it in front of the square leg and takes a single. South Africa are away on day 2!

Once again it's clear blue skies and the sun is out in its full glory. The players are now taking the field. Quinton de Kock and Vernon Philander are the overnight batsmen. Nuwan Pradeep to begin proceedings. Two slips in place along with a gully. Here we go...

We're back folks with all the action of the second day of the first Test match between South Africa and Sri Lanka at the St George's Park, Port Elizabeth. Led by an inspirational bowling performance by Suranga Lakmal, Sri Lanka bounced back yesterday and will be motivated to do even better today. South Africa's plan on the other hand would be to try and bat as long as possible and frustrate the Lankans. Promises to be an exciting couple of hours of the morning session. Stay tuned, the action isn't far away...
...Day 2, First session...

It's been an even start to this Test match but Sri Lanka would feel that they fared better than expected and would like to take it forward. Quinton de Kock holds the key for the Proteas from here on and his innings can prove to be the differential factor. South Africa would hope that the tail wags with him tomorrow and it takes the first innings total close to 350 at least. Do join us for day 2 action at 1330 IST. Cheers!!

Suranga Lakmal was an absolute star. He provided them with the initial breakthrough and also hunted down a couple of wickets in the evening. Rangana Herath also bowled tidily but apart from them the rest were not up to standard. Skipper Angelo Mathews did the holding up job well but that's not what you need on the first day of a Test match.

The South African top half batsmen scored runs in the 20s, 30s, 40s, 50s and 60s but none lasted long to convert it into a big innings. As a result, the day ends with Sri Lanka being the happier side. After the kind of start that the hosts got after electing to bat, it appeared that the Lankans will be in for a tough day but they showed tremendous fighting spirit to bounce back.

End of an absorbing day of Test cricket! Both teams fought well and were up for the challenge. Sri Lanka started in an unconvincing manner but soon got back on track. While South Africa lost the plot after getting a solid opening platform.
Bowls it outside off, swings away but Philanders shoulders his arms to it. That's STUMPS, DAY 1!
There is a mid-wicket in place now, along with a deep point.
Bowls it short outside off from round the wicket, de Kock cuts it to deep point for a single. He is off the strike with a ball to go.
Full and going across de Kock who is more than happy to let it go through.
Slants it outside off, on a length, de Kock is happy to let it pass.
Sprays it wide outside off, de Kock is not interested.
Bowls it full on off, de Kock eases it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On a length outside off, nothing from Philander.
de Kock works it towards square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Philander pushes it towards point for a single.
Hurls it outside off but too wide for a shot by Vernon.
Wide outside off, no shot offered by Philander.
Almost a wicket! Bowls it outside off, de Kock shapes to work it through mid-wicket with a shuffle but gets a leading edge towards point for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl the penultimate over of the day. Most likely that is.
Philander lets this one go through safely.

BEATEN! He's bowled a few of those today! Bowls it outside off on an angle, the ball pitches and goes away a touch, Philander is opened up completely. Lakmal can only smile but Philander will quietly be happy about it, he can bowl many such ones.
Outside off, de Kock guides it behind point for a single.
Goes round the wicket.
Full outside off, Philander pushes it towards covers for a single.
Bowls it outside off, swings away, left alone by Philander.
Fuller on middle, de Kock clips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Philander comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Outside off, Philander gets an outside edge to this length ball from Mathews.
Slants it outside off on a length, Philander is happy to let it go.
FOUR! In the air but safe! Full outside off, Philander is early into his shot but gets it wide of the bowler who cannot catch it in his followthrough. The ball races into the long off fence.
And again! Hurls it outside off on a length, Philander looks to play at it from his crease but is beaten.
Mathews bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty, Philander is unsure and hence hangs his bat out for it and is beaten all ends up.
Lands it outside off on a length, no shot offered.
Slants it outside off on a length, left alone by de Kock.
Full outside off, de Kock pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Slants it across the batsman who is happy to let it go through.
Fuller outside off, de Kock gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, de Kock looks to drive but mistimes it completely.
Outside off, Philander looks to leave but hangs his bat out for it. The ball goes off the face of the bat towards the slip cordon.
Hurls it on a length on off, Philander is beaten by the extra bounce and he takes his bottom hand off the bat to keep it down and in front of him.
Angles it outside off on a fuller length, no shot offered by Philander.
Fuller outside off, Philander gets across and defends it.
Angles it on the stumps, Philander gets across and turns it towards short mid-wicket.
On a length on middle, de Kock turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Vernon Philander is the new man in.

OUT! Faf departs! Lakmal bowls it outside off on a length, Faf has to play at it and gets an outside edge. The ball carries to the first slip fielder. Karunaratne takes a good catch and that is the fourth wicket for Lakmal. Sri Lanka have fought back superbly here.
de Kock turns it through the on side for a single.
FOUR! Crashed! Short and wide outside off, de Kock cuts it hard towards deep point. The fielder tries to stop but ends up pushing it into the ropes. Sums up Sri Lanka's day today.

Shout for an lbw not given! Bowls it outside off, de Kock looks to defend but gets an inside edge. The players appeal but the umpire had spotted the edge there. Somebody wanted to review but was refused in time.
FOUR! Hit away! de Kock gets one on the pads, he does not miss out and clips it away through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, played back to the bowler.
Angled on a length outside off, punched back to the bowler.
EDGED! Outside off, Faf hangs his bat out for it. The ball takes the edge through the gully region for a couple of runs. Mendis and Karunaratne give it a chase and do well to keep them to a couple.
Faf comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
BEATEN! Bowls it outside off on a length, keeps a touch low, Faf is squared up as the ball held its line after coming in with the angle.
Bowls it outside off, comes in, Faf is cramped for room and defends it back down the wicket.
de Kock cuts this one through point for a single.
Angelo Mathews brings himself on for a bowl.
This one is wide outside off, left alone by Faf.
Stays in his crease and defends it back down the wicket.
This one is wide enough for a leave by Faf.
Faf works it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! In the gap! Shorter outside off, Faf punches it through covers. The ball races away to the fence.
Fuller outside off, Faf comes forward and defends it.
Mathews brings back Lakmal for a bowl.
Landed on off, de Kock lunges across and turns it towards the on side.
Fuller outside off, de Kock comes down a touch and pushes it towards covers.
Full outside off, driven to extra cover by de Kock lunging forward.
Shorter outside off, de Kock plays it back down the wicket.
Faf comes down the wicket and clips it through mid on for a single.
Bowls it on middle, Faf pushes it back down the wicket.
The second new ball has been taken immediately by Sri Lanka.
On the stumps, de Kock pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Bowls it on middle, de Kock turns it towards mid on. The bowler goes to his left and stops it.
Fuller on middle, Faf knocks it towards long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, de Kock cuts it hard to deep point for a single.
Landed on off, de Kock defends it towards covers bringing his bat down just in time.
Shorter outside off, de Kock cuts it towards backward point off his crease.
Shorter on off, Faf goes back and works it towards the on side.
Landed outside off, Faf drives it to covers from his crease.
Shorter outside off, Faf punches it towards covers from his crease.
Faf seems to be struggling with his vision.
This one is driven back to the bowler.
Faf comes forward and defends it from his crease.
Flatter outside off, Faf hits it hard to short extra cover.
Faf is getting some eye drops put in. Play is held up.
Flatter on the pads, de Kock turns it towards short leg from his crease.
Shorter on off, de Kock punches it towards point.
FOUR! The shorter one comes from the part-timer, de Kock puts it away through the point fence for a boundary.
Bowls it on middle, de Kock stays back and turns it towards the on side.
Stays back and flays this one towards mid off but finds the fielder. That was a full toss.
Floats it on off, driven towards mid off by de Kock.
de Silva comes on for a bowl.
Coming on the stumps, Faf comes forward to keep it out.
Flatter on middle, Faf comes forward and defends it.
Outside off, Faf comes down, takes it on the full but finds the fielder at short extra cover.
Bowls with the round arm action, Faf stays back and keeps it out towards the on side.
Bowls it on middle, played back to the bowler.
du Plessis turns it towards mid on from his crease.
Angled on a length on off, de Kock defends it from his crease.
Fuller outside off, de Kock plays it through covers for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Faf works it through mid-wicket for a single riding the bounce on this one.
Fuller outside off, Faf drives it towards covers but finds the fielder.
Another length ball outside off, this one is left easily.
WOAH! Bowls it outside off, the ball bounces a lot more on Faf, who is taken aback and has to take his bat out of the way to let it go through.
Flatter outside off, comes in, de Kock turns it towards leg slip from his crease.
Quinton de Kock comes out to bat. Sri Lanka will know that he can really damage their chances here.

OUT! Brilliant review, Angelo Mathews! Flatter on the pads, the arm ball, Bavuma fails to clip it through. The ball hits Bavuma on the pads and the players go up in an appeal but the umpire stays put. They contemplate the review and go for it. The replays confirm there was no bat there. Ball Tracker also shows three reds and Bavuma has to depart. That is the second wicket for Herath, what a wicket for Sri Lanka. The players themselves cannot believe their luck here. A breakthrough out of nowhere.
Bavuma is trapped on the pads by Herath, the umpire does not think it is out. Mathews wants it reviewed.
Loopy on off, Bavuma is watchful as he comes forward to defend it.
Full on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Landed outside off, Bavuma pushes it towards point off his crease.
Floats it on middle, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Bowls it on a length outside off, bounces a touch more but Faf is happy to let it go.

FOUR! Hit away! Shorter length outside off, Faf gets on top of it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He is not going to be troubled by nothing lengths on this wicket. It was asking to be hit and Faf just obliged.
EDGED! Fuller outside off, Bavuma looks to defend from his crease but gets an inside edge through fine leg for a single.
Bowls it around off, Bavuma punches it towards mid on.
Another No ball! Chameers oversteps again, Bavuma clips it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
No ball! Hurls it on the stumps, Bavuma is a touch early but he does well to push it towards mid on. The umpire signals it a no ball for overstepping.
Faf turns one through mid-wicket for a single off his crease.
Bowls it fuller outside off, Faf defends it from his crease.
Dushmantha Chameera returns for a bowl.
Drinks break.
Presses well forward to a full ball and defends it down watchfully.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Flighted around leg, spinning away a touch towards off, Temba gets back and defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Loopy this time but again on the shorter side, Bavuma defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Flatter arm ball on off, a touch on the shorter side, Bavuma goes back and defends it towards the bowler.
Floated one on off, du Plessis drives it to short cover where the fielder misfields and deflects it towards long off. A single taken.
Good length ball on off, Temba taps it down on the off side and looks for a run. He is sent back by his skipper.
Nearly edges it! Pradeep serves a full outswinging delivery outside off, Bavuma without taking his front leg to the pitch of the ball tries to drive and misses.
Full and angling into the batsman, Bavuma defends it solidly from the crease.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, holding its line, Bavuma watches it closely before leaving it for the keeper.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in.

OUT! Loopy ball landing outside off, spinning in, Duminy sits across and tries to sweep it but misses. He is thudded on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up. JP takes the referral and after waiting for a few minutes the third umpire gets to see the replays. First he checks for the front foot no ball but Herath is fine there. Now the Ball Tracker shows that the impact is fine and it's going on to hit middle and leg. The decision remains as it is and it brings an end to an excellent knock by Duminy. He was going great guns and will be disappointed not to score a big one.
Well, well, Duminy is given out lbw. He goes for the review though. That looked out to the naked eye.
Flatter delivery outside off, Duminy goes back and plays it late. Runs it down past first slip for a couple of runs.
Floated one on off, it's driven past the short extra cover fielder and the fielder in the deep makes a tumbling stop. A single taken.
Loopy again but this time it's a low full toss on off, Duminy hits it down the ground to long on for one.
Slow loopy ball on off, full in length, Duminy gets forward and defends it to covers.
Advances down to the pitch of the ball and drives it through mid off for a single.
Straighter in line, du Plessis picks it off his pads, closes the face of his bat and works it through square leg for one.
On a length and outside off, Duminy punches it off his back foot through cover-point for a single.
Good length ball just outside off, angling in a shade, Duminy covers the line and shoulders arms.
Wide outside off, on a fuller length, could have been driven but Duminy has been very watchful and choosy with his shot selection today. Decides to leave this one.
Fullish and speared in on off, Duminy covers the line and blocks it out on the off side.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid off.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run to end the over.
Tossed up ball on off, driven off the front foot to short extra cover.
Bowls it slower through the air, full and drifting in, du Plessis defends it by getting forward.
Too full in length on off, it's pushed off the front foot to short cover.
Once again shorter in length outside off, Faf hits it from the back foot but straight to covers.
A touch short and on off, Duminy gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for three runs.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, nipping in, du Plessis inside edges his attempted forward defense onto the pads.
Angles in a full ball on middle, du Plessis pushes it down to mid on.
FOUR! Bang! Short and wide outside off, du Plessis opens his arms and slams it over backward point for a boundary. Poor delivery won't go unpunished when Faf is batting!
FOUR! Streaky! Good length and outside off, du Plessis gets forward to defend but gets an outside edge past the slip fielders for a boundary.
du Plessis has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery on off, Duminy punches it through covers for a single.
Faf has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy and drifting into the batsman, around off, du Plessis blocks it from the crease.
Tossed up ball outside off, Fad drives it off his front foot to covers.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
A touch short and around off, du Plessis defends it from the back foot.
Full flighted ball on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Rangana Herath comes on for a bowl.
Pitches it full and on off, Duminy drives it off his front foot to short cover.
Good length delivery outside off, Duminy shoulders arms.
Darts in a length ball on off, JP gets half forward and defends it to the off side.
Keeps it on a length and around off, JP defends it from the back foot.
The wind has picked up.
On a length and outside off, Duminy has a watchful leave.

Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Duminy goes back and dabs it down to backward point. Du Plessis is outside the crease looking for a run and is sent back. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Faf is well in.
No ball called for overstepping. Bowls it on a fuller length and outside off, it's left alone by Duminy.
Nuwan Pradeep returns for a spell.
On a length and shaping back in a touch, once again du Plessis plays from the back foot and this time taps it down to point.
Fullish and around off, du Plessis decides to play back from the crease and keeps it out in front of the slip cordon. Should have been forward there!
Bowls it short and on off, 133 kph, Duminy rides the bounce and pulls it all along the ground for a single down to deep mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Duminy gets back inside the crease, goes on top of the bounce and defends it down.
Chameera repeats the last delivery but this time Duminy decides to duck underneath it.
A leg gully in place. Expect more short stuff now.
FOUR! Lakmal digs in a short ball around the rib cage, Duminy top edges his attempted pull shot to fine leg for a boundary. Good surprise delivery by Chameera!
Length ball on off, du Plessis defends it from the crease to the off side. Straight to covers.
Full and swinging around off, du Plessis gets forward in defense.
8th Test fifty for JP Duminy!
FIFTY! Angles in a full ball on off, Duminy lunges and eases it through cover-point for a single. Lovely chanceless knock by him so far.
Duminy has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish and on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.

Beaten comprehensively. Lakmal continues to bowl in a nice rhythm. He runs in from around the wicket and serves a length ball outside off, it curls back in sharply and beats Duminy's forward defensive prod. Cuts him in half and goes past the inside edge. Suranga smiles.
FOUR! Lovely shot from the bat of du Plessis. A juicy full delivery outside off, Faf gets on the front foot and crisply drives it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
A leg stump half-volley, du Plessis whips it through square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Targets the off stump with a length ball, du Plessis covers the line and blocks it safely with a vertical bat.
This one is delivered on a fuller length outside off, Faf restrains himself from driving it.
Lands it on a length and outside off, holding its line, Faf has an easy leave.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Fullish and on off, Duminy draws forward in defense and keeps it out off the inside half of the bat.
Puts it on a length outside off, JP shoulders arms.
Another delivery in the zone outside off, it's allowed through to Chandimal.
Outside off, tapped down to point.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Lands it full and outside off, JP plays a good looking cover drive but for once in this innings fails to find the gap. He has been close to invincible while playing those drives today.
A touch short in length around leg, Duminy turns it down to long leg and crosses for a single.
Digs in a short ball on off, Faf pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Faf offers no shot.
In the channel outside off, du Plessis shoulders arms.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Extra bounce around off, Faf pushes it towards covers and crosses for a brisk single.
Skipper Faf du Plessis is the new batsman.

OUT! The pair of Lakmal and Chandimal hunts down the third wicket! End of Amla's struggle. Lakmal dishes out a full length ball outside off, Amla pushes at it tentatively after being flat-footed and nicks it behind. The keeper stretches to his right to complete the catch. Another failure for Hashim and he walks back disappointed. This was highly unlike attempt from the batsman of his class.
Fullish and on off, JP defends it with soft hands towards cover-point and pinches a single.
Another delivery in the region outside off, not close enough to make the batsman.
Bowls it on a driving length outside off, Duminy decides not to go after it.

Great delivery, Lakmal bowls it from around the wicket and hurls in a full ball just around off, Duminy tries to defend it from the crease but fails to do so as it shapes back in and goes past the inside edge.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla offers no shot.

...DAY 1, SESSION 3...

Much better session for Sri Lanka. They bowled a lot better after lunch and powered by Suranga Lakmal's impressive spell managed to remove both the South African openers. But since then, Amla and Duminy have settled in and the latter in particular has looked in sublime touch. Struggling Amla did offer a chance minutes before the tea break but Chandimal failed to catch it and the home side will hope it doesn't cost them much. Do join us in a short while.

DAY 1... SESSION 2.....

Excellent first session for South Africa. They didn't lose a single wicket and made the Sri Lankan bowlers toil hard. Stephen Cook and Dean Elgar batted patiently throughout. The Lankan bowlers lacked venom. They were not accurate with their lines and lengths and struggled throughout. Cook has crossed his fifty and Elgar is reaching the same. South Africa would look for a big opening stand here. Sri Lanka need to come back hard and need to reassess their bowling plans. Join us back in a bit then to catch the action.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the Boxing Day Test between South Africa and Sri Lanka at St George's Park, Port Elizabeth. It's the first of the three-match series and both sides will want to begin well. The home side are coming off an impressive series win Down Under where they beat Australia 2-1. It is what led to the change of captaincy for them with Faf du Plessis being appointed as the full-time Test captain with the prolonged injury to AB de Villiers. He led his troops well and against an inexperienced Sri Lankan side, the Saffas will hope for another impressive set of performances.
